newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures firm late, most end up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures firm late, most end up.

text.p: Sept 10 - U.S. stock index futures firmed in late trading, and most ended pit trading with tiny gains. Traders said Sept S&P 500s drifted upward late on moderate volume after a choppy session that lacked followthrough. Some said ability to recoup losses despite half-point loss in T-bonds could portend more upside. Focus on Fed Beige Book, U.S. inflation data. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
